title: Domination
summary: DOMINATION, noun [Latin] 1. The exercise of power in ruling; dominion; government. 2. Arbitrary authority; tyranny. 3. One highly exalted in power; or the fourth order of angelic beings. Thrones, domi

inlines.v: DOMINATION, noun [Latin] 1. The exercise of power in ruling; dominion; government. 2. Arbitrary authority; tyranny. 3. One highly exalted in power; or the fourth order of angelic beings. Thrones, dominations, princedoms, virtues, powers.
